## Exact zero-operator typing

```text
K_nonzero_zero = empty set;
K_req_zero     = empty set;

S_out_zero
  = exact admitted finite parent-signal row domain
    under the zero-operator request and predicates;

y_p = 0,  for p in S_out_zero.
```

`S_out_zero` is independent of the empty arithmetic and dependency sets. A
parent row domain is not a `K_req` domain. The zero operator retains exact
parent identity and row support and cannot acquire arbitrary storage rows by a
vacuous universal predicate.

A nonzero convolution is exactly one for which `K_nonzero` is not empty. The
zero operator is therefore distinct from a requested nonzero convolution with
empty ordinary `S_out`.

The zero operator has local fixed-state derivative zero and parent-payload
conditional covariance contribution zero. Complete source response and
systematic uncertainty may remain typed unavailable.
